resources.string: Isexwayiso: Lezi zilungiselelo ziguqula izakhiwo zesistimu ezisezingeni eliphansi. Ezinye izinketho zingase zingasebenzi kwidivayisi yakho noma i-hardware. Ukushintsha amanani ngokungafanele kungabangela amaphutha okubonisa, izinkinga zokusebenza noma ukungasimami. Qhubeka ngengozi yakho.

Ilawula indlela isikrini esibonisa ngayo okuqukethwe, okuhlanganisa isilinganiso sokuvuselela, ukuphenduka, imodi yokuhlangana, kanye nokuziphatha kokucwila. Lokhu kuthinta isibonisi esiyinhloko kanye nomgudu wokunikeza ujwayelekile.
Fihla ibha yesimo kanye nebha yokuzulazula kuso sonke isistimu. Amabha angavezwa ngokuswayipha kusuka emaphethelweni.
Phoqelela isibonisi ukuthi sihlale esililinganisweni sokuvuselela esiphezulu kunazo zonke ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ivimbela isistimu ekusehlisweni kwaso ngokuguquguquka.
Setha isilinganiso sokuvuselela esithile esimisiwe nge-Hz. Sisebenza kuphela uma ukukhiya isilinganiso sokuvuselela kuvuliwe. Setha ku-0 ukuze kuzenzakalele.
Vula ukulungiswa kwesikhathi sokubonisa kwe-GammaOS kwe-VSync, isishejuli, ne-HWComposer. Ithuthukisa ukuhambisana kwamafuremu ku-hardware esekelwayo.
Phoqelela zonke izendlalelo ukuthi zisebenzise ukuhlangana kwe-GPU (iklayenti) esikhundleni sezendlalelo ze-hardware. Kuyasiza uma i-HWComposer ibangela amaphutha okubona.
Isikhathi esincane ngamamillisekendi phakathi kokushintsha ukuphenduka kwesikrini. Kuvimbela ukuphepha-phepha ngokuphenduka okusheshayo. Setha ku-0 ukuze kuvaliwe.
Phoqelela ama-app asemodi yedesktophu ukuthi aqaliswe ngesikrini esigcwele esikhundleni sewindi. Kuyasiza kumadivayisi angenakho ukukhomba kokufaka.
Nikeza igama elikhethekile kusibonakalisi ngasinye esixhunyiwe ngokusekelwe ekuhlonzweni kwe-hardware. Kusiza ukuhlukanisa izibonisi ekusethweni kwezibonisi eziningi.
Gcina izendlalelo ngaphansi uma kudonswa isaziso
Gcina i-app engaphansi ibonakala uma kudonswa ibha yesaziso phansi, esikhundleni sokuyifiphaza.
Bhala phezu kwe-backend yokunikeza ye-GPU. Shiya kungenalutho ngokuzenzakalelayo kwesistimu. Amanani angenzeka: skiagl, skiaglthreaded, skiavk.
Bhala phezu kwesikhathi se-VSync ngama-nanoseconds. Setha ku-0 ukuze usebenzise isikhathi semvelo sesikrini. Isibonelo: 8333333 nge-120 Hz.
Isikhathi isikrini esihlala nesimo sobukhulu besikwele ngemva kokuphenduka ngaphambi kokubuyela. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1200.

Ifaka amafuremu amnyama noma afiphaziwe phakathi kwamafuremu okuqukethwe ukuze kuncishiswe ukufiphala kokunyakaza futhi kulingiswe ukucaca kokunyakaza okufana ne-CRT. Idinga isibonisi esilinganiso sokuvuselela esiphezulu (kunconywa i-120 Hz). Imimodi emibili etholakalayo: CTM (i-matrix yokushintsha imibala, inqubomgomo ye-hardware) ne-RE (RenderEngine, isofthiwe).
Faka amafuremu amnyama phakathi kwamafuremu okuqukethwe ukuze kuncishiswe ukufiphala kokunyakaza.
CTM isebenzisa ukushintsha kombala we-hardware (okusheshayo, okunconywa). RE isebenzisa i-RenderEngine (eguquguqukayo, umthwalo ophezulu).
Okusetwe ngaphambili okuqanjiwe kwephethini yesikali somsebenzi. Shiya kungenalutho ukulawula iphethini ngezandla.
Iphethini yesikali somsebenzi ewenziwe ngezifiso njengamanani okukhanya ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma (0.0\u20131.0). Ibhala phezu kwalokho okusetwe ngaphambili uma kusetwe.
Ukukhanya okuncane kwamafuremu amnyama (0.0\u20131.0). Amanye amaphaneli ayaphepha-phepha ekuqothuleni. Zama 0.01 uma ubona ukuphepha-phepha.
Isikhawu ngamamillisekendi sokuguqula i-polarity ye-BFI. Kuvimbela ukuthambeka kwe-DC kumaphaneli e-OLED. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1000.
Vula i-BFI ye-sub-frame esebenzisa i-RenderEngine ukufaka okumnyama okunemibandela ngaphakathi kwe-VSync eyodwa.
Isinyathelo sokuguquka kwesigaba nge-sub-frame ngayinye. Silawula ubudlelwano besikhathi phakathi kwama-sub-frame. Okuzenzakalelayo: 0.5.
Isiphindaphindo esincane se-cadence sokufakwa kwe-sub-frame. Amanani aphansi avumela ukufakwa okunamandla. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0.
Izinga lokukhanya lefuremu yemthungo (ifuremu 0). Lilawula ukukhanya kwesigodi sokuguqula.
Izinga lokukhanya lefuremu yokuklandela (ifuremu 1). Lilawula umphetho olandelayo womthungo.
Lungisa kahle ukuguquka kokufeyida phakathi kokuqukethwe namafuremu amnyama. Kulawula ubushelelezi, ukulungiswa kombala, kanye nomugqa wokufiphaza wokuguqula kwe-BFI.
Inombolo yamafuremu okuguqula kokufeyida kuphuma (okuqukethwe kuya komnyama). Okuzenzakalelayo: 10.
Inombolo yamafuremu okuguqula kokufeyida kungena (okumnyama kuya kokuqukethwe). Okuzenzakalelayo: 10.
Isiphindaphindo sokugcwala ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0. Amanani aphezulu akhulisa ukucwebezela kwemibala ngesikhathi sokuguqula.
Ukulungiswa kwe-gamma ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0. Amanani angaphansi kwe-1.0 akhanyisa amathoni aphakathi, angaphezu kwe-1.0 awafiphaza.
Bala ngokuzenzakalelayo amazinga okufiphaza okuguqula okushelelezi esikhundleni sokusebenzisa amanani okufiphaza ekuqaleni/ekugcineni ngesandla.
Ukukhanya ekuqondiswe kukho kwemodi yokufiphaza okuzenzakalelayo. Okuzenzakalelayo: 0.92. Amanani aphansi akhiqiza ukufiphaza okujulile.
Vula ukulungiswa kwe-contrast ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhwalithi yokubona.
Isiphindaphindo se-contrast ngesikhathi sokuguqula. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0. Amanani angaphezu kwe-1.0 andisa i-contrast.
Iphoyinti ye-pivot yokukhanya yokulungiswa kwe-contrast. Okuzenzakalelayo: 0.5. Amanani angaphezulu/angaphansi asusa iphoyinti ephakathi ye-contrast.
Sebenzisa ukushintsha kombala we-hardware ye-contrast esikhundleni sesofthiwe. Inempumelelo enkulu kodwa inomkhawulo omkhulu.
Bamba amanani aseduze noqothe abe uqothe oqondile ngesikhathi sokuguqula. Kuvimbela ukukhanya okusele kumafuremu amnyama.
Isiphindaphindo sesizuzo sesiteshi esibomvu ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0.
Isiphindaphindo sesizuzo sesiteshi esiluhlaza ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0.
Isiphindaphindo sesizuzo sesiteshi esiluhlaza sasezulwini ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-flip. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.0.

Isebenzisa imiphumela ye-CRT scanline ne-phosphor esekelwe ku-GPU ekuphumeni kwesikrini nge-SurfaceFlinger. Yakha ukubukeka kwesikrini se-CRT esidala. Idinga ukuhlangana kwe-GPU yeklayenti futhi yengeza umthwalo wokunikeza.
Sebenzisa imiphumela ye-CRT scanline ne-phosphor kukho konke okuphumayo kwesikrini.
Igama lokusetwa kwangaphambili kwe-shader. Shiya kungenalutho nge-CRT shader ezenzakalelayo.
Inombolo yamafuremu okweqa ukuhlola i-backpressure ngemva koshintsho lwe-shader. Kuvimbela ukuma ngesikhathi sokuguqula kwe-shader. Okuzenzakalelayo: 6.

Inikeza i-app efanayo ngezinqubo zokuxazulula ezihlukile ezibonisini zangaphakathi nezangaphandle ngesikhathi esisodwa. Isibonisi sangaphakathi sibonisa uhlobo olunezinqubo zokuxazulula eziphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kanti esangaphandle sibonisa izinqubo zokuxazulula ezigcwele. Kusetshenziswa ukudlala imidlalo esibonisini sangaphandle kanti isikrini esakhelwe ngaphakathi sihlala sisebenza.
Vula ukunikezwa ngezinqubo zokuxazulula ezimbili phakathi kwezibonisi zangaphakathi nezangaphandle.
Shintshana ukuthi yisiphi isibonisi esithola izinqubo zokuxazulula eziphezulu neyiphi ethola eziphansi.
Uhlu lwamagama amaphakheji ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okufanele asebenzise ukunikezwa kwe-Dual-Stack.
Phoqelela ukumisa ama-app uma ushintshanisa phakathi kwemodi ye-Dual-Stack nejwayelekile ukuqinisekisa isimo esihlanzekile.
Sebenzisa ukukala ngomakhelwane oseduze (i-pixel ebukhali) kwesibonisi esizinqubo zokuxazulula eziphansi. Vala ukuze kukale nge-bilinear (okushelelezi).
Sebenzisa i-Dual-Stack kuphela ezendlalelweni ze-SurfaceView (okuqukethwe komdlalo) futhi ushiye izingxenye ze-UI ezinqubeni zokuxazulula zemvelo.
Gcina i-SystemUI (ibha yesimo, ukuzulazula) ibonakala ngezinqubo zokuxazulula ezigcwele kwimodi ye-SurfaceView kuphela.
Inombolo enkulu yama-buffer e-framebuffer atholakele kwimodi ye-Dual-Stack. Okuzenzakalelayo: 3.
Khubaza i-OpenGL backpressure kwimodi ye-Dual-Stack. Kuvimbela ukuwa kwamafuremu kodwa kungandisa ukubambezeleka.

Ilawula indlela izibonisi zangaphandle (HDMI, USB-C, DisplayPort) eziphathwa ngayo. Ihlanganisa izinketho zokwenza isibonisi sangaphandle sibe esiyinhloko, ukuphoqelela imodi yesibuko, ukuqondisa ama-app athile, nokulungiswa kwezinqubo zokuxazulula.
Phatha isibonisi sangaphandle njengesibonisi esiyinhloko. Isikrini esakhelwe ngaphakathi siba esesibili.
Phoqelela zonke izibonisi zangaphandle ukuthi zibukise isibonisi esiyinhloko esikhundleni sokunweba idesktophu.
Guqula usayizi wokuphuma kwesibuko ukuze kufanele nezinqubo zokuxazulula zesibonisi sangaphandle esikhundleni sokudonsa.
Nciphisa izibonisi zangaphandle ze-4K zibe uhhafu wezinqubo zokuxazulula (1080p). Ithuthukisa ukusebenza kumadivayisi abunzima ngokuphuma kwe-4K okugcwele.
Gcina isibonisi sesibili sivuliwe ngisho noma isistimu ngokuvamile ingasivala.
Igama lephakheji noma isici sesikhahlamezi sesibonisi sesibili. Isibonelo: com.android.launcher3/.secondarydisplay.SecondaryDisplayLauncher
Qalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ama-app abekiwe esibonisini sesibili esikhundleni sesiyinhloko.
Uhlu lweziqalo zamagama amaphakheji ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okuqondiswa esibonisini sesibili.
Inombolo yamafuremu okubambezeleka okuphuma kwesibonisi esiyinhloko. Kusetshenziswa ukuvumelanisa isibonisi. Okuzenzakalelayo: 0.
Inombolo yamafuremu okubambezeleka okuphuma kwesibonisi sangaphandle. Kusetshenziswa ukuvumelanisa isibonisi. Okuzenzakalelayo: 0.

Izilawuli zokugxila, ukufaka, kanye nokuziphatha kokukhanya kwezibonisi eziningi. Lezi zilungiselelo zithinta indlela isistimu elawula ngayo ukugxila nokufaka phakathi kwezibonisi eziningi ezixhunyiwe.
Vumela zombili izibonisi ukuthi zigxile ekufakweni ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ivula ukusebenzisana okuzimele kusibonakalisi ngasinye.
Vumela ukulawulwa kokukhanya okuzimele kwesibonisi ngasinye esixhunyiwe esikhundleni sokukhanya okuhlanganisiwe.
Ilawula lapho ikhibhodi yesofthiwe (IME) ibonakala khona ekusethweni kwezibonisi eziningi. Phina ikhibhodi esibonisini esithile noma ishintshele esibonisini sesibili.
Phina ikhibhodi yesofthiwe esibonisini esithile esikhundleni sokulandela iwindi eligxilile.
I-ID yesibonisi lapho i-IME kufanele ibonakale khona uma iphinwe. 0 = isibonisi esakhelwe ngaphakathi, 1+ = izibonisi zangaphandle.
Hambisa ikhibhodi esibonisini sokuqala esingesona esizenzakalelayo. Kusetshenziswa kuphela uma kungekho i-ID yesibonisi ebekiwe ngokusobala.
Ukuqondisa umsindo nokubhala phezu kokulawulwa kwevolumu. Kuhlanganisa izilungiso zomsindo we-HDMI ezikhethekile ze-chipset ye-Unisoc ne-Allwinner.
Vula ukulawulwa kwevolumu okuzimele kwemifudlana yomsindo ehlukene (amamidiya, isaziso, i-alamu).
Vula ukuphuma komsindo we-HDMI kuma-chipset e-Unisoc. Kusebenza kuphela kumadivayisi asekelwe ku-Unisoc.
Vula ukuphuma komsindo we-HDMI kuma-chipset e-Allwinner. Kusebenza kuphela kumadivayisi asekelwe ku-Allwinner.

Ukumisa kwe-daemon ye-GammaPad. Ibamba amadivayisi okufaka e-gamepad engokoqobo, iwahlanganisa abe isilawuli se-Xbox esisodwa esiyifayela, futhi ihlinzeka ngokumapisha kabusha kwamabhatani, ukulungiswa kwezinduku, kanye nokulingisa kwemodi yemawusi.
Qalisa i-daemon ye-GammaPad ukuze ubambe futhi umapishele kabusha amadivayisi okufaka e-gamepad.
Hlanganisa amadivayisi okufaka engokoqobo amaningi abe i-gamepad eyodwa engokomfanekiso.
Fihla amanodi amadivayisi engokoqobo asekuqaleni kuma-app uma ebanjwe yi-GammaPad.
Amagama amadivayisi ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okubamba. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kutholwe ngokuzenzakalela ama-gamepad.
Shintshana ngezikhundla zamabhatani e-A/B ne-X/Y phakathi kwesakhiwo se-Xbox ne-Nintendo.
Phendula umgqa we-Y wenduku ye-analog yangakwesokunxele.
Phendula umgqa we-Y wenduku ye-analog yangakwesokudla.
Guqula ukufaka kwenduku ye-analog yangakwesokunxele kube izehlakalo zomkhombandlela we-D-pad.
Guqula ukufaka komkhombandlela we-D-pad kube izehlakalo zenduku ye-analog yangakwesokunxele.
Umkhawulo wokuphambuka kwenduku ye-analog (0\u2013100) ukuze kuqalise isehlakalo se-D-pad. Okuzenzakalelayo: 50.
Ukulungiswa kobuzweli obujwayelekile kuzo zonke izinduku ze-analog. 0 = okuzenzakalelayo, amanani aphozithivu andisa, amanegathethi anciphisa.
Vula ukuphuma kokudlidliza okusekelwe ku-PWM kwemiphumela yokudlidliza.
Igama elibikwa yidivayisi ye-gamepad engokomfanekiso. Okuzenzakalelayo: Xbox Wireless Controller.
Ukumisa kokumapisha kabusha kwamabhatani. Ifomethi: src1=dst1,src2=dst2 (amakhodi ezinkinobho ze-Linux).
Ukumisa kokumapisha kabusha kwemigqa. Ifomethi: src1=dst1,src2=dst2 (amakhodi emigqa ye-Linux).
Mapisha ukuhlangana kwamabhatani kube izehlakalo zokhiye olulodwa. Ifomethi: btn1+btn2=key,btn3+btn4=key.
Mapisha izehlakalo ze-axis zibe ukucindezela amabhatani. Ifomethi: axis:threshold=key (isib. 5:128=304).
Indlela eya edivayisini ye-force feedback yokuphuma kokudlidliza. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kutholwe ngokuzenzakalela.
Amagama amadivayisi ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okukhishwa ekubanjweni futhi adluliswe ngokuqondile.
Vula imodi yokumapisha amabhatani e-gamepad kusikrini sokuthinta.

Misa imodi yokulingisa imawusi ye-GammaPad. Uma ivulwe ngokuhlangana kwamabhatani, induku ye-analog ye-gamepad ilawula isikhozo semawusi. Kuyasiza ukuzulazula ama-app ngaphandle kokufaka okuthintekayo.
Isivinini sokuhamba kwesikhozo uma usebenzisa induku ye-analog. Okuzenzakalelayo: 12.
Isivinini sokuhamba kwesikhozo uma usebenzisa i-D-pad. Okuzenzakalelayo: 6.
Isiphindaphindo sesivinini uma ibhatani lokukhulisa libanjwe (inani / 10). Okuzenzakalelayo: 20 (2.0x).
Isivinini sevili lokuskrini uma usebenzisa induku ye-analog yangakwesokudla (inani / 10). Okuzenzakalelayo: 4 (0.4x).

Ithatha amasampula emibala eyinhloko yesikrini futhi iyikhiphe kuma-RGB LED e-gamepad noma edivayisini ukuze kutholakale imiphumela yokukhanyisa ekunombeni (ngendlela ye-Ambilight). Isebenza ngaphakathi kwe-SurfaceFlinger ukuze kuthathwe amasampula ngokubambezeleka okuncane.
Thatha amasampula emibala yesikrini futhi uyikhiphele kuma-RGB LED ukuze kukhanyiswe ekunombeni.
Izikhathi ezingaki ngomzuzwana ukuthatha amasampula emibala yesikrini. Ibanga: 1\u201360. Okuzenzakalelayo: 6.
Fiphaza ama-LED ngokulinganayo nezinga lokukhanya kwesikrini.
Feyida ngokushelelezi phakathi kwezinguquko zombala esikhundleni sokushesha ngokushesha.
Isilinganiso samafuremu omfanekiso okuguqula kokufeyida. Ibanga: 1\u2013240. Okuzenzakalelayo: 60.
Thatha amasampula emibala yesikrini ngaphambi kokuba imiphumela ye-CRT shader ne-BFI isebenziswe. Ikhiqiza imibala enembile.
Umphumela wofanekiso we-LED oqanjiwe. Shiya kungenalutho kwimodi yombala othathwe esikrinini.
Thatha amasampula ngamahlangothi wesokunxele nawesokudla esikrini ngokuhlukana izindawo ze-LED ezimbili.
Khulisa ukugcwala kwemibala ukuze kutholakale okuphuma kwe-LED okucwebezela ngamandla. Okuzenzakalelayo: 1.4.

Ivimbela ama-app ashayela ebekiwe ekuqaliseni ama-app okuqondiswe kuwo abekiwe. Kuyasiza ukuvimbela ukuqaliswa kwama-app okungafuneki kuma-frontend afana ne-Daijishou noma i-ES-DE angaqalisa ngephutha umlingisi ongalungile.
Vimbela abashayeli abekiwe ekuqaliseni ama-app okuqondiswe kuwo abekiwe.
Uhlu lwamagama amaphakheji ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okufanele avinjelwe ekuqaliseni izinhloso.
Uhlu lwamagama amaphakheji ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma lapho abashayeli kufanele bavinjelwe ekuwaqalisa.
Ukubhala phezu kwezinga lesistimu okuhlukene okuhlanganisa ukubonakala kwamathayili e-Quick Settings, imikhawulo yezinqubo zangemuva, ukuhluzwa kwezenzo zokuvusa, kanye nokukhetha imodi yokusebenza.
Uhlu lwamagama amathayili e-Quick Settings ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma okuwafihla kususelwa ekukhethweni kwamathayili.
Inombolo ephezulu yezinqubo zangemuva ezivunyelwe. Amanani aphansi akhulula i-RAM kodwa angabulala ama-app. Okuzenzakalelayo: isistimu iyaphatha.
Hluza izenzo zokuvusa ezithile ukuze kuvikelwe ukuvuka kwesikrini okungahlosiwe. Izihlonzi zezenzo ezihlukaniswe ngamakhoma.
Iphrofayili yokusebenza yokulungisa i-CPU/GPU governor. Izinketho: stock, performance, powersave.
